d:
Suman dreams of starting her own achaar business to become financially independent and bring her children back, who live with her ex-husband, Dilip. With Shukla Ji's help, she takes her first steps towards entrepreneurship, only to discover that he has been deceiving her. Determined to stand on her own feet, Suman decides to take matters into her own hands. Will she be able to overcome this setback and take her first step towards her dream? Watch Ep01 to find out!
Credits:
Directed by: Apoorv Singh Karki
Produced by: Arunabh Kumar
Created by: Arunabh Kumar & Apoorv Singh Karki
